cemc-fryer-2018-04a.prompt:
A *Bauman number* is a positive integer each of whose digits is 1 or 2. Each Bauman number consists of *blocks* of digits. Each block contains at least one digit and includes all of the consecutive equal digits. For example, 2222111112111 is a 13-digit Bauman number consisting of four blocks: a block of four 2s, then a block of five 1s, then a block of one 2, then a block of three 1s; 2222222 is a 7-digit Bauman number consisting of a single block of seven 2s.

(a) How many 3-digit Bauman numbers are there?
